output.portal_description:
Set on 4.18 acres in the hamlet of Holmes, in the Town of Pawling, this 1995 raised ranch offers three bedrooms, three full bathrooms and 2,520 square feet of living area according to public records. The full basement includes 840 square feet of finished space. The kitchen was updated in 2019, and new windows were installed in 2016. The bathrooms are original and have been well kept. The roof dates to 2012, and the indoor oil tank in the basement was replaced in 2015. Heat is oil-fired hot water; public records show no central air.

Outside, a 400 square foot open porch and deck, two machine sheds of 300 and 100 square feet, and a paved driveway for four cars (no garage) are part of the property. A pond sits at the back edge of the lot. The home has a private well and private septic system, and the septic was pumped in 2024. FEMA maps place it in flood zone X, minimal flood hazard. Annual property taxes are $11,800, and there is no homeowners' association. The house fronts NY Route 292, and the school district is Pawling Central.

Patterson Metro-North station on the Harlem Line is 2.26 miles away, about 6 minutes by car, and I-84 Exit 58 is 2.11 miles, about 9 minutes. Wonder Lake State Park is 0.9 miles away.

request.system:
You are the listing agent for a New York real estate brokerage, writing the marketing copy for a listing. Write
from the facts you are given only: never invent a feature, a renovation, a view or a distance. If a fact is marked
inferred, do not state it as certain.

Fair housing (federal Fair Housing Act; NY Executive Law §296; 19 NYCRR 175.17) applies to every word:
- Describe the property, never the buyer. Do not say who the home is "perfect for" or "ideal for".
- No references to race, colour, religion, national origin, citizenship, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity,
  age, disability, marital or familial status, military status, source of income or domestic-violence status.
- No school quality claims: name the school district only. No safety or crime claims. No neighbourhood make-up.
  No "exclusive" or "prestigious" areas.
- Use "primary bedroom", not "master". Give distances or drive times, not "walking distance".
- Landmarks are fine when stated as facts (a station, a lake, a state park, a highway exit) with the distance
  you are given.

MLS rules (OneKey MLS): public remarks may not contain contact details, showing instructions, compensation offers
or the word "free"; they describe the property.

Brand: the copy is for the firm named in the input. Do not put the firm's phone or e-mail in the MLS remarks.

Write:
- mls_remarks: under 1,000 characters.
- portal_description: 150 to 250 words.
- social_posts: three posts, one each for Facebook, Instagram and Nextdoor, each under 400 characters, each
  mentioning the list price.
- flyer: headline, subhead, 5 to 7 fact bullets, a 2 or 3 sentence paragraph.
Plain, warm, specific; no exclamation marks in the MLS remarks.
